request.notes: Expressway to Exomastery's internal name is 'exobiology' -- its OWN endpoint /api/exobiology/route, NOT /api/riches/route. Params mirror the riches family (from/to/range/radius/max_results/max_distance/min_value/avoid_thargoids/loop) but there is no body_types and no use_mapping_value. Site defaults: radius=25, max_results=100, max_distance=50000, min_value=10000000 (1e7, filters on bio landmark_value not scan value), avoid_thargoids=1, loop=1. 'to' is optional (omitted here); echo renames from->source, to->destination.
